data.body_html:
Combine the thrill of deep-sea fishing with the romance of a Mediterranean sunset on the Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2040. This 4-hour experience from Puerto Banús gives you two hours of rod-and-reel action off Cabopino, then two hours cruising the Marbella coastline as the sun drops behind La Concha. From €749 for the whole boat (up to 11 guests), it’s the most efficient way to tick two bucket-list items off in one afternoon.

Why choose the Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2040?

Most charters force you to choose: fishing or sunset. This combo gives you both in a single 4-hour slot, with no extra cost for gear or skipper. You’ll depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella’s most glamorous marina, and head east to the fishing grounds off Cabopino. After two hours of casting and reeling, the skipper turns west toward the Golden Mile, where the sky turns amber over the sea. It’s a seamless transition from adrenaline to apéritif.

Which boats are available?

This experience runs on two of our most popular models:

  • Astondoa 40 – 12.5m, 9 guests, €749/2h → €2,299/8h
  • Azimut 39 – 12.5m, 11 guests, €749/2h → €2,299/8h

Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. The Astondoa 40 is a bit more intimate; the Azimut 39 has a slightly larger cockpit. Choose based on your group size.

What’s the fishing experience like?

The skipper knows the best spots off Cabopino, Río Verde, and the reefs near Cala del Faro. You’ll fish for sea bass, bream, mackerel, and bonito – and occasionally small tuna in late summer. All gear is provided: rods, reels, bait, and lures. The skipper handles the rigging and helps you land the fish. No licence needed. Catch-and-release is standard, but you can keep what you catch if you want to cook it later.

Sunset cruise along the Marbella coastline

Once the fishing lines are stowed, the boat cruises west past the Marbella Marina, the Golden Mile, and the silhouette of La Concha mountain. The skipper will anchor near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés – two of the best sunset spots on the Costa del Sol. You’ll sip cava, nibble snacks, and watch the sky shift from gold to pink to deep blue. The boat returns to Puerto Banús just after dark.

Pricing and inclusions

The Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2040 is priced as a custom 4-hour slot. You can book it as a 2-hour fishing + 2-hour sunset experience for €749 (based on the Tier A boats). If you want more time, the 8-hour charter costs €2,299 and includes a lunch stop at a beach club or a swim at Cala Cortés.

Every charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Fishing gear (rods, reels, bait, lures)
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • 21% Spanish VAT

How to book

Contact us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and any dietary requirements. We’ll confirm availability on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 and send a payment link. A deposit secures the slot. For more options, browse our full fleet of boats in Puerto Banús.
